answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn: one identity, one bond, slashed if peers prove duplicate or fake work. A Sybil attacker must then fund each fake identity separately, so the cost scales linearly with the size of the fake fleet - like trying to fill an ocean one marble at a time, each marble bought with real money. Honest agents recover their bond and keep working in the same grove, while the attacker capital stays locked or burns.
